```yaml
name: Bump openinference-instrumentation version

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  bump:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Get latest openinference-instrumentation release tag
        id: get_latest
        run: |
          TAG=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/openinference/openinference-instrumentation/releases/latest | python -c "import sys, json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['tag_name'])")
          echo "latest_tag=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Read last recorded tag
        id: read_last
        run: |
          if [ -f .github/last_instrumentation_release.txt ]; then
            LAST_TAG=$(cat .github/last_instrumentation_release.txt)
          else
            LAST_TAG=""
          fi
          echo "last_tag=$LAST_TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Determine if bump is needed
        id: bump_needed
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.get_latest.outputs.latest_tag }}" != "${{ steps.read_last.outputs.last_tag }}" ]; then
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Update dependencies
        if: steps.bump_needed.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          NEW_VERSION=${{ steps.get_latest.outputs.latest_tag }}
          echo "Bumping openinference-instrumentation to $NEW_VERSION"
          find . -type f -name 'pyproject.toml' -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
            sed -i -E "s/(openinference-instrumentation[<>=]*)([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)(.*)/\\\\1${NEW_VERSION}\\\\3/" "$file"
          done
          find . -type f \( -name 'setup.cfg' -o -name 'requirements.txt' \) -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
            sed -i -E "s/(openinference-instrumentation[<>=]*)([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)(.*)/\\\\1${NEW_VERSION}\\\\3/" "$file"
          done
          echo "$NEW_VERSION" > .github/last_instrumentation_release.txt

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.bump_needed.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: bump openinference-instrumentation to ${{ steps.get_latest.outputs.latest_tag }}"
          branch: "bump-openinference-instrumentation-${{ steps.get_latest.outputs.latest_tag }}"
          title: "chore: bump openinference-instrumentation to ${{ steps.get_latest.outputs.latest_tag }}"
          body: |
            This PR updates the minimum version of **openinference-instrumentation** to `${{ steps.get_latest.outputs.latest_tag }}` across all Python instrumentor packages.
            It ensures that all dependencies are aligned with the latest release.
          labels: "chore"
```
